user.title: Apple TV Audio Output
user.description: Adds actions and entities that send an Apple TV's sound to AirPlay speakers. The Apple TV itself must be set up with the Apple TV integration. Afterwards, select Configure to choose speakers an Apple TV should always play to.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

init.title: Default speakers
init.description: Choose an Apple TV. Its sound will be sent to the speakers you choose next whenever it wakes up.

speakers.title: Default speakers
speakers.description: Choose the speakers, or type an AirPlay name or id. Leave it empty to stop sending this Apple TV's sound to default speakers.

abort.no_apple_tvs: No Apple TV was found. Set up the Apple TV with the Apple TV integration first.

set_output.name: Set audio output
set_output.description: Sends the Apple TV's sound to these AirPlay speakers only. Does nothing when they are already the only outputs. Can return the outputs before and after the change.

speakers.name: Speakers
speakers.description: AirPlay speakers: their AirPlay name, a media player entity of the speaker, or an AirPlay id.

force.name: Force
force.description: Send the command even when the speakers are already an output.

retries.name: Retries
retries.description: How many times to send the command again, a few seconds apart, when a speaker does not become an output. Helps right after the Apple TV wakes up.

fail_if_not_applied.name: Fail if not applied
fail_if_not_applied.description: Make the action fail when a speaker does not become an output, instead of only logging a warning.

add_output.name: Add audio output
add_output.description: Adds AirPlay speakers to the Apple TV's current audio outputs. Does nothing when they are already an output. Can return the outputs before and after the change.

speakers.name: Speakers
speakers.description: AirPlay speakers: their AirPlay name, a media player entity of the speaker, or an AirPlay id.

force.name: Force
force.description: Send the command even when the speakers are already an output.

retries.name: Retries
retries.description: How many times to send the command again, a few seconds apart, when a speaker does not become an output. Helps right after the Apple TV wakes up.

fail_if_not_applied.name: Fail if not applied
fail_if_not_applied.description: Make the action fail when a speaker does not become an output, instead of only logging a warning.

remove_output.name: Remove audio output
remove_output.description: Removes AirPlay speakers from the Apple TV's audio outputs. Can return the outputs before and after the change.

speakers.name: Speakers
speakers.description: AirPlay speakers: their AirPlay name, a media player entity of the speaker, or an AirPlay id.

get_outputs.name: Get audio outputs
get_outputs.description: Returns the Apple TV's current audio outputs, with the volume of each where available.

get_speakers.name: Get AirPlay speakers
get_speakers.description: Returns the AirPlay speakers found on the network, with the names and ids the other actions accept.

rescan.name: Scan again
rescan.description: Scan the network now instead of using the speakers found recently.

set_volume.name: Set speaker volume
set_volume.description: Sets the volume of one speaker that the Apple TV is playing to.

speaker.name: Speaker
speaker.description: An AirPlay speaker: its AirPlay name, a media player entity of it, or its AirPlay id.

no_apple_tv.message: The action did not target any Apple TV media player.

not_apple_tv.message: {entity_id} is not an Apple TV media player.

unsupported_version.message: The Apple TV integration in Home Assistant {version} works differently from what Apple TV Audio Output expects. Please report this as an issue.

speaker_not_found.message: No AirPlay speaker named "{name}"{source} was found. Found: {found}.

speaker_ambiguous.message: More than one AirPlay speaker is named "{name}"{source}. Use the AirPlay id of the one you mean: {ids}.

command_failed.message: Could not change the audio output of {entity_id}: {error}

volume_not_supported.message: This version of Home Assistant cannot set the volume of a single speaker. Update Home Assistant to use this action.

unsupported_version.title: Apple TV Audio Output does not work with this Home Assistant version
unsupported_version.description: Home Assistant {version} changed the Apple TV integration in a way Apple TV Audio Output does not expect, so it cannot change the audio outputs. Please report this at {url}, and check for an update of Apple TV Audio Output in HACS.
